poisson_log). What we were worried about is the unusual
vertical bar syntax.

The thing to remember is that

y ~ foo(theta);

is just shorthand for

target += foo_lpdf(y | theta);

with the slight difference that the ~ form drops
constant terms.

On Wednesday, July 13, 2016 at 11:27:28 PM UTC+10, Bob Carpenter wrote:
We were hoping _lpdf and _lpmf would be more intuitive
than _log (and less conflicted with distributions like
poisson_log).  What we were worried about is the unusual
vertical bar syntax.  

The thing to remember is that

  y ~ foo(theta);

is just shorthand for

  target += foo_lpdf(y | theta);

with the slight difference that the ~ form drops
constant terms.

- Bob
